commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
cd /tmp/bloomml-m03.Iyqgfp/source
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d77a722e45799a81ea0d7a47adacd62b8040a232
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = 2e816ce6a8b57d47e98028b3f27d6f359c40025e
test -z "$(git diff --name-only)"
test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)"
git diff --cached --stat
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 7
git diff --cached --check
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('web/src/domain/ipo-profile.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old='    "gpio.relay": "gpio:4", "pwm.channel": "pwm:0", "modbus.relay": "modbus:1:1",'
assert s.count(old)==1
assert '"shelly.meter":' not in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,old+'\n    "shelly.meter": "shelly:" + id,'))
p=Path('web/src/domain/ipo-board-readiness.test.ts')
s=p.read_text()
old='import { assessIpoProfile, createDefaultIpoProfile, validateIpoProfile } from "./ipo-profile"'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,'import { assessIpoProfile, createDefaultIpoProfile, createIpoDevice, validateIpoProfile } from "./ipo-profile"')
old='    p.devices.push({\n      id: "meter_1", label: "Shelly", driver: "shelly.meter",\n      locator: "shelly:meter_1", enabled: true,\n    })'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,'    p.devices.push(createIpoDevice("meter_1", "shelly.meter"))\n    expect(p.devices[p.devices.length - 1].locator).toBe("shelly:meter_1")')
p.write_text(s)
PY
git add web/src/domain/ipo-profile.ts web/src/domain/ipo-board-readiness.test.ts
git diff --cached --check
make test-ipo
python3 scripts/check_runtime_boundaries.py
python3 scripts/check_output_rf_ownership.py
python3 scripts/check_runtime_config_ssot.py
cd web
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm lint
pnpm build
cd ..
git commit -m "feat(ipo): declare optional electrical input channels without device authority"
echo "M03_STAGE4_LOCAL_SHA|$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "M03_STAGE4_PASS_NO_PUSH"
